rationale: The assistant ended up on the right cause (drawer left ajar), but only because the customer volunteered it. It never asked what the display showed, never mentioned the alarm-off button, never explained the recovery time, and never advised checking the soft ice cream or thawed food. The seal and hinge questions were off target, and the closing 'Good news, that has sorted it' was overconfident given the beeping may not have stopped. The replacement-model panel was irrelevant and implied a purchase where none was needed, though no specific part was recommended.
